file = open("scores.txt", "r")

total = 0
count = 0
for line in file:
    fields = line.strip().split(",")
    name = fields[0]
    score = int(fields[1])
    print(name + " scored " + str(score))
    total = total + score
    count = count + 1

file.close()
print("Average: " + str(total / count))
description: You split file lines into fields and compute an average from numeric scores.
